answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before claiming paid work, returned only after independent verifiers attest the result. One honest agent reuses a single stake across many jobs, like an oasis it keeps returning to, while a sybil farmer must lock fresh capital for every fake identity, so attack cost scales linearly with the number of sock puppets. At the zenith of a flood the ledger shows thousands of staked claims with no verifiable history, and the market prices them at the ledge: unproven identities earn nothing until a stake survives real verification.
